jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Self Improving Software
jobs.description:
As a Staff Product Manager on Datadog's Self-Improving Products team, you will take a new product family from zero to one: a closed loop that watches how a customer's software and its users behave, ranks what is worth changing, proposes the change, proves whether it worked, and carries the result into the next cycle. Datadog already holds every piece this product needs, including behavioral data from Product Analytics and Session Replay, full-stack telemetry from APM, Log Management, Error Tracking, and Continuous Profiler, rollout control through Feature Flags and Experimentation, and a coding agent in Bits AI Dev Agent that opens verified pull requests from production signal. You will own assembling these into one product where the loop closes on its own. This is founding work with no precedent inside Datadog, and an opportunity to grow as a product leader by shaping the scope, recruiting the first design partners, and setting the quality bar for an AI-native product from the ground up.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Set product direction for a new product family by defining the problems and desired outcomes, and partnering with engineering to find the narrowest first slice that proves the loop closes and delivers value to customers in phases.
  • Own the product decisions at every stage of the loop: what signal is trustworthy enough to trigger an automated change, which opportunities rank highest and with what confidence, what a proposed change must contain before a customer merges it, what evidence proves it worked, and what the system remembers for the next cycle.
  • Define the autonomy ladder and its limits, from suggestion, to draft, to auto-opened pull request, to auto-rollout, along with the controls, defaults, and audit trail customers need to rely on it. Some rungs stay off by design, and you own those decisions.
  • Set the quality bar for a product that is non-deterministic: build the evaluation sets with engineering, decide what "good enough to ship" means, and hold that bar when it moves a date.
  • Recruit the first design partners yourself, sit in their triage rotations, turn what you learn there into the roadmap, and keep talking to them after launch.
  • Develop and defend the sizing, impact, and cost-to-serve analysis that engineering leadership and pricing partners need to make resourcing calls, partnering with engineering on the unit economics of inference and the data platform and bringing that cost profile into packaging, metering, and pricing before launch rather than after.
  • Deliver concise written and verbal communication to executive, engineering, and customer audiences, clarifying complex architecture, quality trade-offs, and go-to-market, including where agentic observability, product analytics, and experimentation are heading and how that shapes the product.

 

Who You Are:

  • You have shipped AI products, not prototypes: you have taken at least one AI-native product to production customers, and you can describe what it got wrong in the field and what you changed in response.
  • You treat evaluation as product work: you have built or commissioned evaluation sets, set the bar for shipping a model or prompt change, and held that bar under schedule pressure.
  • You are fluent in agent failure modes and design for non-determinism deliberately, accounting for confidence, reversibility, blast radius, review surfaces, and graceful failure.
  • You have a zero-to-one track record: you have started something with no roadmap and no team and got it to customers who renewed, you narrow ruthlessly, and you have ended a direction you championed and can explain why.
  • You read across staff engineers, consuming product teams, sales and FinOps, marketing, and finance, and turn diffuse signals into a defensible product position.
  • You are collaborative, opinionated, and comfortable with ambiguity: you build trust quickly with engineers, PM peers, designers, and commercial partners, you bring strong product opinions and adapt as new evidence emerges, and you write the document that gives diffuse work a shape.
  • You have 8+ years of Product Management experience, or a track record showing Staff-level capabilities in related software roles. We weigh shipped AI products and zero-to-one evidence more heavily than years.
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience (preferred).

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, Customer Success, and regional teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and scale customer participation across Datadog initiatives
  • Ensure insights from Ambassadors, Champions, User Group participants, speakers, and other community members are shared with the appropriate teams inside Datadog, strengthening the connection between our customers and our products
  • Balance strategic leadership with selective hands-on contribution, including coaching speakers, reviewing technical content, participating in community programs, and representing Datadog when appropriate

 

Who You Are: 

  • You are an experienced people manager who has led autonomous technical professionals, coached performance, developed talent, and translated complex goals into achievable plans
  • You have experience defining and delivering successful developer advocacy, developer relations, technical community, or a related functions

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Developer and Agentic Experience
jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for a Senior Product Manager to define and execute the strategy for our Developer and Agentic Experience across MongoDB Atlas which is our best-in-class, fully managed, multi-cloud database service.  

In this role, you will shape how developers, platform teams, and AI agents build on and operate Atlas through programmatic interfaces such as APIs, CLI, Agent Skills, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). You will turn complex infrastructure operations into intuitive, reliable, and increasingly automated experiences that accelerate customer adoption and drive Atlas growth.

You will own the vision, strategy, and 12-month roadmap, including how Atlas evolves to support AI agents. AI agents are changing how teams build and operate cloud infrastructure, and this role will shape how Atlas leads that change.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do

  • Own the vision, strategy, and 12-month roadmap for Developer and Agentic Experience, balancing the needs of developers, platform teams, enterprise customers, and the AI agents.
  • Simplify how customers build and operate Atlas by evolving individual programmatic capabilities into cohesive, end-to-end workflows for deploying, operating, and optimizing Atlas
  • Shape Atlas's agentic experience by making Atlas easy for AI agents to discover, understand, and safely operate, while keeping developers in control
  • Drive adoption and revenue growth by identifying high-impact opportunities across programmatic experiences and defining their business models, pricing, and packaging
  • Lead customer discovery and product validation with developers, platform teams, and enterprise customers, translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to frame problems, define requirements, make tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality products from discovery through launch and iteration
  • Own product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for your products, translating product value into compelling customer narratives and driving launches and adoption in partnership with Sales and Customer Success
  • Establish clear success metrics for adoption, retention, and Atlas consumption through programmatic usage, using product analytics, customer feedback, and market signals to evaluate progress and adjust priorities
  • Communicate product direction and decisions clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, including the rationale behind what we will and will not build

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products used by developers or technical teams
  • A track record of defining product strategy and delivering products used by technical audiences, ideally across developer tools, CLIs, APIs, agentic platforms, Infrastructure-as-code(IaC), or cloud platforms
  • Experience growing adoption and revenue for a product, including business cases, pricing and packaging, and go-to-market plans
  • Experience translating ambiguous customer and business problems into focused strategies, product narratives, roadmaps, and prioritized execution plans
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across engineering and product teams without relying on formal authority
  • Experience building and scaling products for enterprise customers and individual developers, balancing the needs of large organizations, technical teams, and individual developers
  • Excellent customer instincts, including the ability to lead high-stakes conversations with enterprise customers
  • Comfort working with AI-enabled product experiences and evaluating where automation, guidance, and human control create the most value
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts clear and compelling
  • A bias toward action, disciplined prioritization, and the judgment to make decisions with incomplete information

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with MongoDB, Atlas, or comparable database or cloud platforms
  • Experience with developer platforms and infrastructure as Code(IaC) tools such as CLI, APIs,Terraform or cloud provider tooling
  • Experience building products for AI agents, such as MCP servers, agent skills, or AI coding tool integrations
  • Experience with self-serve growth, developer onboarding, or usage-based pricing
  • Experience working across cloud and local development environments

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

The Developer Platform team at Auth0 (an Okta company) owns the platform that developers build identity on. The opportunity

We're hiring a Principal Engineer (P5) to serve as the technical leader and compass for the Developer Platform team. You'll work across the breadth of the platform, tackling the highly complex, vaguely specified problems that span it and turning them into clear technical direction the team can execute against, without day-to-day oversight. Above all, you'll own how the platform is architected to scale: the distributed systems behind it, the reliability and consistency guarantees developers depend on, and the coherence that keeps it easy to build on as usage grows. You'll champion the team's technical execution, raise the engineering bar, mentor the people around you, and partner with tech leads across teams to keep the wider platform aligned. You'll have real influence over how our platform holds up in a world where developers and agents are both first-class consumers.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the platform architecture: Set the technical direction for the developer platform, and make the cross-cutting decisions that keep it coherent and easy to build on as it grows.
  • Architect for scale: Design the distributed systems behind the platform for throughput, reliability, and consistency, so the guarantees developers depend on hold up under real load.
  • Turn ambiguity into direction: Take the hardest, most vaguely specified platform problems and turn them into clear, modular technical designs the team can execute against.
  • Design for developers and agents: Shape the platform so it holds up whether a person or an agent is calling it, and so both can build and automate their work against Auth0.
  • Raise the engineering bar: Set the standard for how the team designs, builds, and operates the platform, and lead deep, constructive reviews that grow the engineers around you.
  • Partner across teams: Operate peer-to-peer with tech leads in adjacent groups to review major architectural decisions and keep the wider platform aligned.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record as a Principal or Staff level individual contributor.
  • Distributed architecture depth: Extensive experience designing and operating high-scale, reliable backend and event-driven systems, with a strong grasp of the tradeoffs in throughput, consistency, and failure handling.
  • Platform thinking: A track record of designing and shipping platforms or developer-facing systems at scale, with an instinct for the interfaces and abstractions that keep them coherent as they grow.
  • IAM platform thinking: Deep understanding of identity and access management, with a sense for the platform capabilities and abstractions that make identity easier for developers to build on.
  • Ownership in ambiguity: You can own vaguely specified problems and drive them to a clear technical direction without heavy top-down scoping.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: Strong Node.js fundamentals; Go a plus.
  • Agent-aware design: Hands-on familiarity with agentic tooling, MCP, or LLM-facing design, and a sense for how agents consume a platform.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Experience working across engineering, product, and architecture in a fast-moving environment, and a habit of raising the bar for the people around you.

Extra credit

  • Work with agent frameworks, AI-facing systems, or developer toolchains in the LLM space.
  • A background at a company where developers are the primary customer.
  • Experience setting technical direction for a platform that other engineering teams build on.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Security Engineer, Customer Identity, Advanced Threat Protection

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth. 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

 

The Role 

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

Responsibilities:

  • Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)  
  • Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
  • Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses  
  • Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there  
  • Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited  
  • Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants  
  • Establish and execute a long-term engineering and threat research roadmap for Advanced Threat Protection aligned with company-wide business and security goals.
  • Own high-impact security architecture designs and decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure to support long-term threat resilience.
  • Drive cross-functional security strategies and partner across engineering, product, and enterprise security leadership across Okta to influence platform-wide standards and policies.
  • Actively coach, mentor, and level up Senior (P3) engineers and team members, fostering technical excellence, research discipline, and leadership growth.

What this position is not: 

  • Dedicated application security, code review, or compliance-focused work  
  • Reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them

Requirements:

  • You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks  
  •  8+ years of experience in security engineering, with a proven track record of setting technical vision, driving cross-organizational initiatives, and leading architectural choices in cloud/product security.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring senior-level engineers, defining multi-quarter technical strategy, driving architectural consensus, and influencing cross-organizational security initiatives.  
  • You have hands-on development experience — Go preferred — sufficient to prototype tooling, build AI-powered defenses, and operationalize your research  
  • You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following:  
    • AWS and/or Azure security  
    • Kubernetes  
  • You have strong knowledge of OWASP (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices  
  • You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices  
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams  
  • You have experience working with a globally distributed and remote team

Bonus points if:

  • You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security  
  • You have built AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment  
  • You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following:  
    • Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research  
    • The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications  
    • Identity and access management  
    • Full-stack engineering  
    • Site reliability engineering  
    • Vulnerability and threat management  
    • Governance, risk and compliance

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Staff Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

About You

Production builder: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

Careful evaluator: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

Strong owner: You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

What you will be doing

  • Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.
  • Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.
  • Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state.
  • Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.
  • Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding.
  • Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
  • Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

What you will bring to the role

  • Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools.
  • Hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation.
  • Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant.
  • Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
  • Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

Scope by level

Staff: Lead a domain such as harnesses, evaluations or model quality across workers and implement its critical components.

Our stack

Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan.

We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts.

And extra credit for

  • Open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.
  • Fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.
  • Identity and security workflows. Foundation-model research experience is optional.

You’ll own the roadmap and execution for Terminal’s developer-facing surface: the client SDKs (JavaScript, iOS, Android, React Native, .NET, and Java), the integration primitives developers depend on, and the documentation and example apps that help them make their first successful charge. About the team

As part of the Enterprise Product team, the Enterprise Engineering team is responsible for bridging the gap between Stripe's core capabilities and the bespoke needs of the world's largest organizations. Our mission is to improve Stripe's product-market fit with enterprise users to win more deals and grow revenue, while giving every enterprise user an excellent experience as they onboard, activate, and grow their business with Stripe.

Enterprise Engineering tackles ambiguous, complex problems in a cross functional manner to deliver an exceptional Enterprise experience on Stripe.  The key missions of the team is to 1) develop specialized Enterprise-grade product features for industry verticals 2) provide a configuration platform that streamlines onboarding Enterprise users onto Stripe and 3) deliver a consistently great and smooth experience when migrating sensitive data onto Stripe.

  • Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation
  • Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes

Who you are

  • Strong analytical capability and ability to quickly ramp up in a new area, and tackle ambiguous problems
  • Enjoy and have experience building end-to-end solution, including full development lifecycle of deploying and maintaining this infrastructure
  • Experience with web software development
  • Hold yourself and others to a high bar when working with production systems

  • Able to think outside of the box and be creative in designing and delivering the best solutions for our users

The Direct Surfaces Team’s mission is to make it delightful for users to manage their money. This is a 0 → 1 new business at Stripe so if that sounds exciting we’d love to hear from you!

Full-stack engineers at Stripe are comfortable working on new products under fluid conditions, seamlessly balancing tactical and strategic considerations. 

 

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, expand and maintain UIs their related APIs and services
  • Work with our partners to design and launch new features and capabilities

  • Develop and execute against both short- and long-term roadmaps. Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation

We’re looking for fullstack software engineers with experience building scalable products who have an eye for detail and are happy delivering changes at any layer of the technical stack.

  • Have a strong technical background, including 3+ years of industry experience building high quality code and infrastructure
  • Have experience in ensuring great user experience and ease of use of features and products you build

Engineering works closely with a variety of teams: Sales and Support to better understand our customers’ needs, Legal and Accounting to understand how global policies influence our money-moving infrastructure, etc.

  • Have experience using React Native
  • Have experience in ensuring great user experience and ease of use of features for products you build.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Stripe Tax
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team 

Collecting and filing sales & indirect taxes is a classic area for technology disruption. Companies selling across countries, states, and even smaller jurisdictions have to navigate through a myriad of tax rates, product-level tax exemptions, filing requirements, and registration obligations. The rules are constantly changing, and not accurately calculating and filing tax can have legal ramifications.

It’s no surprise then that solving tax compliance is a top user request. We launched Stripe Tax as a new SaaS product in 2021 to make tax compliance as effortless as possible. The Stripe Tax team builds the systems and experiences that help businesses understand where they have obligations, calculate the right tax, and automate reporting and filing. We solve this at a global scale for users ranging from ambitious startups to the world’s largest enterprises, whose requirements demand exceptional correctness, extensibility, and operational rigor.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced technical leader to shape the architecture and technical roadmap for Stripe Tax. You will work alongside leaders across engineering, product, design, operations, and go-to-market teams to turn complex and evolving tax requirements into simple, reliable experiences for millions of businesses. You will lead high-impact, multi-team efforts, make durable technical decisions, and raise the bar for how we build and operate Stripe Tax.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical strategy and execution for Stripe Tax’s most important and ambiguous product and platform investments, from early exploration through production adoption
  • Work backwards from the needs of complex global businesses and evolving tax regulations to identify high-leverage opportunities and shape the product roadmap
  • Partner with engineering, product, design, operations, legal, go-to-market, and infrastructure leaders to align teams and deliver cohesive tax experiences across Stripe
  • Design and evolve scalable, resilient systems and data models that meet the exceptionally high standards for correctness, auditability, security, and availability required in tax
  • Drive interoperability across Stripe products and external tax ecosystems, scrutinizing service boundaries, interfaces, and data contracts to keep the platform extensible
  • Raise the engineering bar through hands-on technical leadership, clear decision-making frameworks, operational excellence, and mentorship that accelerates other engineers

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of industry software engineering experience building and operating large-scale, distributed systems
  • Deep software engineering expertise, with a track record of making sound architectural decisions while remaining hands-on in the code
  • A track record of leading complex, multi-team technical programs from ambiguous problem definition through successful delivery and adoption
  • The ability to set long-term technical direction, identify the highest-leverage investments, and make progress amid uncertainty and competing constraints
  • Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to build alignment among senior technical, product, and business stakeholders without relying on authority
  • A commitment to growing other engineers through mentorship, technical feedback, and a culture of rigorous, inclusive, and data-informed decision making

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in tax, financial technology, payments, accounting, financial reporting, or another domain where correctness and regulatory complexity are central
  • Experience working directly with large enterprise customers and translating their complex requirements into durable platform capabilities
  • Experience designing robust integrations with external systems and APIs, or leading platform work that spans backend services, data, and user-facing experiences
